title: triteleia crocea
intro: Triteleia crocea, commonly known as Golden Dwarf Lily, is a perennial flowering plant native to the western United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments and has been found to have potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Triteleia crocea include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
